correctness.rationale: The block-Laplacian eigenvalue decomposition gives tau=det(L_path+2diag(w))/2 exactly. The unique positive budget root yields an AR(1) precision matrix with all inverse diagonals equal, certifying all logdet gradients. Strict concavity globally proves uniqueness even against boundary/asymmetric allocations; a closed AR(1) determinant produces the optimum and the explicit root its two asymptotic laws. A standalone checker passed 793 exact rational determinant, matrix inverse, cofactor, budget and sample-comparison checks; the infinite statement rests on the analytic argument.

value.rationale: The all-budget exact solution of independent rung resource allocation on every fixed-rail finite ladder is a natural D-optimal graph-design problem. It establishes a nontrivial endpoint premium and a scale-separated, quantifiable boundary/bulk allocation law, while proving unrestricted global uniqueness and optimal value instead of reporting numerical KKT solutions.
